meta.title: Submit the proposal with "Requirement - Purpose of this item / Service" empty
gaps: Set up the specifically named closed RFQ with bids A 100 and B 90, 10 requested units, and award all 10 specifically to Vendor B; the prepared state has exactly one line item, one invited vendor, and one bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set up the specifically named closed RFQ with bids A 100 and B 90, 10 requested units, and award all 10 specifically to Vendor B; the prepared state has exactly one line item, one invited vendor, and one bid.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding flow needed to create a proposal.
Attempt to allocate the line item to the case's named Vendor B before creating the proposal.
Create the draft proposal so its form can be tested.
Confirm that proposal creation opened the proposal page.

args.goal: on the proposal page, fill every required proposal field except “Requirement - Purpose of this item / Service”, leave that field empty, click “Submit Proposal”, and stop when the proposal form shows the required-field refusal

steps.note: Perform the proposal-form interaction that no dedicated catalog step can express, including leaving the target field empty and submitting.

args.field: Requirement - Purpose of this item / Service

steps.note: Assert that the omitted field is highlighted with the required-field error.
Confirm the proposal remains unsubmitted on the proposal form.
